test_Dict_equality: test that two Dict spaces with the same keys and values are equal
test_Dict_inequality: test that Dict spaces with different keys, values, or names are not equal
create_Dict_space: create a Dict space with Discrete subspaces using compiler_gym.spaces.Dict
run_dict_space_tests: run the Dict space equality and inequality test suite with pytest
review_Dict_comparison: review the Dict space equality and inequality comparison logic in test_equal and test_not_equal
